G8_family_repair.family_skeleton: question/claim -> evasive or clever answer -> induced follow-up/correction -> punchline/tag
G8_family_repair.objective: Reduce cross-character voice homogenization without deleting legitimate humor or making every line task-functional.
G8_family_repair.selection_rule: Prefer the most portable, least character-specific instances. Preserve instances whose mechanism depends strongly on a unique object, shared history, status pressure, injury, task conflict, ritual or relationship-specific running joke.

hold_not_mandatory_repair.rule: Do not force a geography rewrite unless the source manuscript itself supplies enough evidence to resolve the ambiguity safely.

A repair ledger mapping each changed region to Phase346 finding IDs and intended effect without storing manuscript prose in the public repository.
A targeted post-edit G6D check proving both deterministic temporal blockers are closed.
A full-manuscript G8 pattern-family recount/reassessment proving the F1 risk was reduced or explaining why further reduction would damage character-specific dialogue.
A protected-dialogue recheck showing the repair did not flatten relationship-specific speech.
A downstream continuity check for facts, knowledge, objects, rules and relationships touched by edits.
next_action: Bind the untouched historical candidate by exact SHA-256, create a new private repaired copy, close the two temporal-semantic blockers, minimally rework 2-5 weakest F1 instances, run targeted G6D plus full-manuscript G8/protected-dialogue checks, preserve the repair evidence, and stop before final promotion.
